findings.passage: During the 87th Legislature, Christina supported public education, worked to expand ethnic studies across the state, passed consumer protection bills, and fought to defend voting rights.
findings.note: Official House biography. A general line about voting rights in 2021. It names no ID or citizenship rule. The page carries no date.

findings.passage: We fought for voting rights, Medicare expansion, women’s reproductive rights, and the needs of our community.
findings.note: From her constituent newsletter, looking back on 2021. A general line about voting rights. It names no ID or citizenship rule.

findings.motion: HB 802, early voting by mail by any qualified voter (referred to Elections committee)
findings.note: She is the author. The bill removes the reasons a voter must meet to vote by mail, so all registered eligible Texas voters could vote by mail. It was referred to committee on 2021-03-01. Her 2022 newsletter describes it the same way.

findings.motion: SB 7 (87th regular session), election integrity and security: passed by the House, Record 848, 78 yeas, 64 nays
findings.note: The House Journal lists C. Morales among the nays on passage of SB 7, relating to elections, including election integrity and security.

findings.motion: SB 1 (87th 2nd called session), election integrity and security: passed by the House, Record 61, 80 yeas, 41 nays; she was listed as absent
findings.note: The House Journal lists C. Morales as absent (not as excused) on passage of SB 1. No vote was cast.

findings.motion: SB 1 (87th 2nd called session): House adoption of the conference committee report, Record 118, 80 yeas, 41 nays; she was listed as absent
findings.note: The House Journal lists C. Morales as absent (not as excused) on adoption of the conference committee report on SB 1. No vote was cast.

findings.motion: SJR 37, constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen: adopted by the House, Record 2196, 102 yeas, 14 nays, 22 present not voting
findings.note: The House Journal lists C. Morales among the members recorded as present, not voting, on final House adoption of SJR 37. The same was recorded on 2025-05-09 when SJR 37 passed to third reading (Record 1897).
